overview: Jamie is a close-range fighter that specializes in poking, footsies, and harassment, with quick normals that he can use once he's in. He also benefits from a powerup system that allows his damage potential and flexibility to snowball the more chances he gets to power up.

Jamie's key mechanic is based on taking drinks. By using his forward throw, The Devil Inside, the Freeflow Kicks ending to his Freeflow Strikes special move, or certain target combos, Jamie can increase his Drink Level, up to a maximum of 4. Each time he drinks, his damage increases, bringing him to standard damage at Drink Lv. 2 and putting him above it at Drink Lv. 3 and higher. He also unlocks more target combos and special moves at specific Drink Levels, gradually opening up the complexity of his moveset and increasing his flexibility significantly; his most notable special move unlocks, in ascending order from Drink Lv. 1 to 4, are his aerial special move Luminous Dive Kick, his anti-projectile and super cancel bridge Bakkai, the command throw Tenshin, and the super-cancelable follow-up to his advancing move Swagger Step, the Swagger Hermit Punch. Jamie can also temporarily boost himself to Drink Lv. 4 (if he isn't already there) by using his Lv. 2 Super Art, The Devil's Song; if he already has 4 drinks, it instead becomes a tool to quickly replenish Drive Gauge and lets him keep up the pressure.

As far as his selection of normals and specials go, Jamie has 5MK, 2MK, and 5HK as strong cancelable pokes, as well as a grounded overhead in 6MK. He can use these moves, as well as careful uses of Freeflow Strikes and Swagger Step, to pester the opponent at close and mid range until they make a mistake. He also has 2HP and Arrow Kick as anti-air options, with Overdrive Arrow Kick explicitly serving as a reversal against aggressive opponents. Successful hits with sweep, Freeflow Strikes, Punish Counters, or any moves that knock the opponent down and away will give Jamie more time to drink without fear of repercussion, especially against opponents that aren't able to establish strong enough ranged pressure to stop Jamie from drinking when he's farther away from them.

In exchange for how powerful drinks make Jamie, though, it is no exaggeration to say that his gameplan is very much reliant on getting them, even if he doesn't make it to Drink Lv. 4 in a given round. Without drinks, Jamie lacks a lot of his most powerful tools, in addition to missing out on damage; it becomes an uphill battle to keep up unless he's gotten a few sips in, even with The Devil's Song acting as a Hail Mary option to close the gap in emergencies. It is also worth noting that Jamie's Drink Level does not carry over between rounds, meaning that he has to be prepared to get set up all over again, but once he gets going, he's a real menace. If you're looking for a bit of breaking and swaying alongside an infighter that only gets stronger when he's loaded up, then Jamie is your man.

moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL4: 720/760/800/840/880; grounded Punish Counter crumple is +9 before opponent becomes airborne; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; very long range for cancelable normal; on midscreen Punish Counter, can safely cancel into 2 Drinks (corner: Drink, juggle 2LP > 214PP, juggle 2HK~HK~P); SA2 cancel: +19/+11 (PC: KD+87); Drink cancel: -25/-33 (PC: KD+43); special/DR cancel is delayed until after 2nd active frame; extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles

moves.name: Stand HP (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL4: 810/855/900/945/990; very fast startup for heavy normal; 3 hits (can break Drive Impact from close range); great option out of Drive Rush (forward momentum, plus on block, combo on hit) or vs. opponent in Burnout; 3rd hit has longer range (effectively 12f startup with better frame advantage when spaced out); all hits receive counter-hit/Punish Counter advantage; Punish Counter Drive damage will not occur if the attack is canceled; all 3 hits put airborne opponent into limited juggle state (juggling into last 2 hits will maintain juggle state); SA2 cancel: +11/+5; Drink cancel: -33/-39; special/DR cancel is delayed until after 3rd recovery frame on 2nd hit

moves.name: Stand LK (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL4: 270/285/300/315/330; chains into 5LK/2LP/2LK; chaining out of 5LK shifts Jamie's position forward, making light combos more consistent; chains into itself infinitely even on whiff (different animation than when chained into from other normals); SA2 cancel: +9/+5; Drink cancel: -35/-39; DR cancel is delayed until after 2nd active frame

moves.name: Stand LP (DL0)
moves.notes: Drink Lv.0 only (changes at DL1-DL4); better frame advantage than the DL1-DL4 version, but has less range and no Target Combo; SA2 cancel: +7/+2; Drink cancel: -37/-42

moves.name: Stand LP (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL1-DL4: 285/300/315/330; requires Drink Lv.1 or higher; cannot link afterward naturally, but gives new Target Combo follow-up; good range for a light normal (slightly shorter range vs. crouching opponents); SA2 cancel: +7/+2; Drink cancel: -37/-42

moves.name: Bitter Strikes 1 (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL1-DL4: 190(170)/200(180)/210(188)/220(198); () refers to scaled damage when starting combo with 5LP

moves.name: Bitter Strikes 2 (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL1-DL4: 475(380)/500(400)/525(420)/550(440); 2f extra recovery on block; important combo tool after 5LP at DL1 and above (combos from max range 5LP); () refers to scaled damage when starting with 5LP~LK; SA2 cancel: +13/+6; Drink cancel: -31/-38; special cancel is delayed until after 1st recovery frame; DR cancel is delayed until after active frames

moves.name: Stand MK (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL4: 540/570/600/630/660; good poke and mid-range buffer; lifts up leg hurtbox on frames 4-12 (can avoid low pokes); 1f extra recovery on whiff; can combo naturally into 214MP/214PP; extends a wider hurtbox on whiff until the end of recovery; SA2 cancel: +15/+10; Drink cancel: -29/-34

moves.name: Stand MP (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL4: 540/570/600/630/660; good combo and frame trap starter, but has no conversions near its max range

moves.name: Neutral Taunt (DL0-DL3)
moves.notes: "Where's my bed? You're putting me to sleep, man."; has a different variation at Drink Lv.4

moves.name: Neutral Taunt (DL4)
moves.notes: "You're still here? This... is your last chance."

moves.name: Arrow Kick (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL4: 1260/1330/1400/1470/1540 (Chip: 315/332/350/367/385); on hit, a follow-up occurs with 8f landing recovery (19-42f full invuln, vulnerable to projectiles before invincibility starts); cannot hit cross-up; can juggle into 623KK or SA1 after a high airborne connect in the corner

moves.name: Arrow Kick (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL4: 1350/1424/1500/1574/1650 (Chip: 337/356/375/393/412); on hit, a follow-up occurs with 11f landing recovery (15-38f full invuln, vulnerable to projectiles before 2nd hit invincibility starts); Jamie's primary reversal; cannot hit cross-up

moves.name: Arrow Kick (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL4: 900/950/1000/1050/1100 (Chip: 225/237/250/262/275); on hit, a follow-up occurs with 11f landing recovery (16-42f full invuln, vulnerable to projectiles before invincibility starts); cannot hit cross-up; sets up a safe jump in the corner (or midscreen if no back rise); can juggle into 623KK, SA1, or SA3 after a high airborne connect (623KK requires corner positioning)

moves.name: Arrow Kick (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL4: 1080/1140/1200/1260/1320 (Chip: 270/285/300/315/330); on hit, a follow-up occurs with 18f landing recovery (17-40f full invuln, vulnerable to projectiles before invincibility starts); cannot hit cross-up

moves.name: Tenshin (DL3)
moves.notes: Damage DL3-DL4: 682/715; cannot be canceled into from normals; Jamie is +28 before crumpled opponent goes airborne into a free juggle state; leaves enough frame advantage to dash or Drive Rush into a grounded combo; does not benefit from Counter/Punish Counter bonus frame advantage; Range: 0.96

moves.name: Tenshin (DL3)
moves.notes: Cannot be canceled into from normals; leaves opponent standing on hit for a grounded combo; does not benefit from Counter/Punish Counter bonus frame advantage; starter scaling is applied to the 3rd hit of the combo, while immediate scaling applies if Tenshin is comboed into (e.g. after Stun, PC Drive Impact, or corner PC 214PP)); Range: 0.96

moves.name: Ransui Haze (DL4)
moves.notes: Drink Lv.4 only; can be performed on whiff; follow-up special changes based on button timing (Close/Mid/Far refer to the distance Jamie has walked back away from the opponent); 27f hitconfirm window refers to the total time of 6HK~4HK before Headbutt must be input, but the 4HK itself must be input within 20f (more lenient on CH/PC)

moves.name: Ransui Haze Headbutt (DL4)
moves.notes: Drink Lv.4 only; 3f gap on block; combos naturally on hit (relatively confirmable); cancelable into any special or Super; startup includes 6HK plus the delay before Headbutt can be input; SA2 cancel: KD+54/+10; Drink cancel: KD+10/-34; special/DR cancel is delayed until after active frames; puts airborne opponents into free juggle state (e.g. if opponent tries to jump after 6HK)

moves.name: Ransui Haze Drink (DL4)
moves.notes: Drink Lv.4 only; can be performed on whiff; restores 1 bar of Drive gauge on the final recovery frame (2 bars if no input is made until frame 112); startup includes 6HK plus the delay before Drink can be input

moves.name: Ransui Haze Triple Fist (DL4)
moves.notes: Drink Lv.4 only; can be performed on whiff; can punish attempts to chase down the sway; first hit has short range and may whiff if the opponent is stationary; final hit is cancelable into any special or Super; startup includes 6HK plus the delay before Spin can be input; SA2 cancel: KD+57/+13; Drink cancel: KD+13/-31

moves.name: Senei Kick (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL3: 810/855/900/945; safe poke with long range that can combo after CH/PC/DR or into Super; not a low attack despite the animation; gains ~6% more range and a Target Combo follow-up at Drink Lv.4; SA2 cancel: +19/+13

moves.name: Senei Kick (DL4)
moves.notes: ~6% more range than DL0-DL3 versions; not a low attack despite the animation; has a Target Combo follow-up into 4HK with 3 possible enders; TC confirm into 4HK~Headbutt requires Counter-hit; 22f hitconfirm window refers to latest possible 4HK input, but must be input within 20f for Counter-hit combo to work; SA2 cancel: +19/+13

moves.name: Leg Sweep (Block)
moves.notes: Performed by inputting 6HPHK during blockstun; 5f extra recovery on hit; freezes the screen for 4f during startup; see Drive Reversal.

moves.name: Leg Sweep (Recovery)
moves.notes: Performed by holding 6HPHK on wakeup; 5f extra recovery on hit; does not have any screen freeze except for a 12f freeze when interacting with the opponent's throw hitbox (this also refunds 1 Drive bar after punishing the throw); see Drive Reversal.

moves.name: Falling Star Kick (DL0)
moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL1: 540/570; 10-19f Low Crush; gains ~25% more range and Target Combo follow-up at Drink Lv.2; can be spaced to hit later in active frames for better advantage; causes spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents

moves.name: Falling Star Kick (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL2-DL4: 600/630/660; 10-19f Low Crush; ~25% more range than DL0-DL1 version; has a Target Combo follow-up; can be spaced to hit later in active frames for better advantage; causes spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents

moves.name: Full Moon Kick (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL2-DL4: 200x2/210x2/220x2; allows a combo from overhead without Drive Rush, but difficult to confirm on reaction; MK follow-up is 2 hits

moves.name: Full Moon Kick + Drink (DL2)
moves.notes: Increases Drink Level by 1; better to use midscreen, as opponent can't effectively take advantage of Jamie's -1 KD situation; Drink Level is built on 54th recovery frame; gives better advantage upon DL3 to DL4 drink activation, allowing for corner oki; refills 0.5 Drive bars; at DL4, refills 1 Drive bar; does not come out if you continue holding a kick button after 6MK~MK

moves.name: Forward Taunt (DL0)
moves.notes: "Bring it!"; Changes with each Drink Level

moves.name: Forward Taunt (DL1)
moves.notes: "Come on, let me see your sick flow!"; Changes with each Drink Level

moves.name: Forward Taunt (DL2)
moves.notes: "You gonna show me some moves? Don't screw up!"; Changes with each Drink Level

moves.name: Forward Taunt (DL3)
moves.notes: "You think you knew what I'm gonna do next?"; Changes with each Drink Level

moves.name: Forward Taunt (DL4)
moves.notes: "I ain't through with you.... zzz ... oh man, oh man."; Changes with each Drink Level

moves.name: Vainglory Strike (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL4: 720/760/800/840/880 (Chip: 180/190/200/210/220); See Drive Impact. Airborne connect gives spinning juggle state on Punish Counter or corner Wall Splat with variable height.

moves.name: Luminous Dive Kick (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL1-DL4: 760/800/840/880 (Chip: 190/200/210/220); during forward jump only; connecting lower to the ground gives better frame advantage; grounded hit puts opponent into limited juggle state; OTG bounce on airborne hit; can be done low to the ground with Tiger Knee motion (214~9K); can be used to bait throw techs or as an escape from corner throw loops; Jamie is crouching on the final landing recovery frame with a standing-sized hurtbox (IASA: this tall crouching hurtbox lasts up to 39 more frames when holding any crouch after landing)

moves.name: Luminous Dive Kick (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL1-DL4: 950/1000/1050/1100 (Chip: 237/250/262/275); forward jump only; button strength determines angle; connecting lower to the ground gives better frame advantage; can be done very low to the ground with Tiger Knee motion (214~9K); can get a follow-up juggle after low grounded hit; spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents (no juggle); can be used to bait throw techs or as an escape from corner throw loops; Jamie is crouching on the final landing recovery frame with a standing-sized hurtbox (IASA: this tall crouching hurtbox lasts up to 39 more frames when holding any crouch after landing)

moves.name: Jump HK (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL4: 360x2/380x2/400x2/420x2/440x2; both hits put airborne opponents into limited juggle state (follow-up is always possible); if 1st hit is stand blocked, the 2nd hit will not hit overhead against crouch block; lower body projectile invuln 8-25f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Jump HP (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL4: 720/760/800/840/880; has juggle potential; causes spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents; lower body projectile invuln 10-23f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Jump LK (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL4: 270/285/300/315/330; longest horizontal range of all Jamie's air normals

moves.name: Jump LP (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL4: 270/285/300/315/330; cross-up with a narrow hitbox; can be used as a fuzzy instant overhead

moves.name: Jump MK (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL4: 450/475/500/525/550; cross-up; lower body projectile invuln 7-20f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Jump MP (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL4: 630/665/700/735/770; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; cancels into j.214K from forward jump (DL1 or higher); lower body projectile invuln 7-22f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Back Shaver (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL4: 1080/1139/1200/1259/1320 (PC: 1836/1937/2040/2141/2244); +4 after Forward Dash, allowing corner throw loops (or midscreen if opponent doesn't Back Rise); Jamie can also hold LP+LK to sacrifice oki for a Drink Level; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: Back Shaver + Drink (DL2)
moves.notes: Damage DL0-DL4: 1080/1139/1200/1259/1320 (PC: 1836/1937/2040/2141/2244); leaves Jamie too far for follow-up oki, but can get corner pressure with ranged normals like 5MK; LP+LK must be pressed on frame 92 of throw animation for the drink to occur; builds an extra 0.5 Drive bars, or an extra 1 Drive bar at DL4; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: Drive Parry
moves.notes: See Drive Parry. Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

moves.name: Drive Rush Cancel
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

moves.name: Parry Drive Rush
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: 0.988 (min/throw), 2.03 (min/block), 3.002 (max/final DR frame)

patches.summary: Ingrid Release. Minor system changes and bug fixes.
notes: Full Moon Kick (6MK~MK)
Increased forward movement and expanded the attack hitbox and proximity guard hitbox of the 2nd hit
This makes it easier for the 2nd attack to connect at more ranges (after the patch that increased the pushback of blocked overheads)
Reduced pushback on hit/block for the 2nd attack to pull the opponent closer to Jamie

patches.summary: Alex Release. Balance changes for all characters.
notes: 2LK hitstun 14 → 16; Hit Advantage +1 → +3; now combos into 2MK out of Drive Rush
2MK hitbox expanded forward; Range 1.42 → 1.46
5HP 2nd hit reduced air knockback; 3rd hit increased air knockback time and expanded the combo-only hitbox upward (more consistent in certain juggle routes)
Falling Star Kick (6MK) increased pushback on block
Ransui Haze Headbutt (DL4 6HK~4HK~P) attack startup reduced 15 → 14; active frames 4 → 5; Block Advantage -12 → -13; KD Advantage +32 → +31
Cancels from the backstep 1f earlier; combined with faster startup, it now frame traps 4-frame buttons after blocked 6HK
DL4 Freeflow Strikes 2nd hit (236P/PP~6P) added an extended combo-only hitbox and adjusted pushback to ensure the combo does not drop after the initial hit connects
OD Bakkai (236KK) startup reduced 21 → 18; 1st hit active frames increased 3 → 6; recovery decreased 62 → 59
Block Advantage -46 → -43; final hit launches opponent higher, KD Advantage +12 → +23; Hitconfirm window 74 → 77

patches.summary: C. Viper Release. Minor bug fixes and adjustments for some characters.
notes: Freeflow Strikes Drink Lv.4 (236P) expanded collision box upward when first attack hits to prevent later hits from whiffing under the opponent

patches.summary: Elena Release. Balance changes for all characters.
notes: Back Walk
Fixed issue where movement speed was slower when continuously holding back
2LP
Drive Rush momentum lasts 1f longer (stays closer, but harder to shimmy on block)
5MP
Hit Advantage increased +5 → +6
Hitstun increased 23 → 24
Grants a new link to 2MP and a Counter-hit link to 2HP at close range, and a whiff punish link to SA3
5MK
Startup reduced 10 → 9
Whiff recovery increased 17 → 18
Extends a hurtbox on whiff until the end of recovery
Now an important link after Punish Counter 2MP at some ranges, like when punishing Drive Reversal
2MP
Whiff recovery increased 13 → 15
Total whiff animation increased 21 → 23
Extended foot hurtbox expanded upward and lasts until end of whiff recovery
5HP
Collision box extended upward (less likely to whiff under opponents in juggles)
5HK
Hit Advantage increased +1 → +3
Hitstun increased 25 → 27
DR Cancel Hit Advantage increased +14 → +16
Gains several new combo options:
5HK > 236HK (DL2) cancel route
5HK > DRC, link 5HK
DR~5HK, link 2MP/2MK
2HP
Startup reduced 9 → 8
Total animation reduced 36 → 35
Head hurtbox air invuln shifted 1f earlier (8-32f) to match the new startup
Now fast enough to link after meterless command grab for much more damage
Causes less horizontal blowback when landing on an airborne opponent
Bitter Strikes (5LP~LK~MP)
Hit Advantage increased -2 → -1
Hitstun increased 22 → 23
Can now cancel into HP Freeflow Strikes for more damage and corner carry
Phantom Sway (Modern Controls: 3H~H~H)
Input timing for the Drink shifted 3f later and less likely for accidental inputs to occur
Full Moon Kick (DL2 6MK~MK~P)
Will no longer perform a Drink if the second kick button is held down
Modern Controls (DL2 6M~M~M): Input timing for the Drink shifted 2f later and less likely for accidental inputs to occur
Intoxicated Assault (DL3 4HP~HP~HK)
Fixed issue where the hurtbox before the 3rd hit was set to Counter-hit instead of Punish Counter
Ransui Haze (Modern Controls: DL4 6H~4H~H)
Input timing for 3rd hit shifted 3f later and less likely for accidental inputs to occur
The Devil Inside (22P)
Fixed issue where Jamie would not recover Drive gauge if the button was held while going from DL3 → DL4
LP/MP Freeflow Strikes (236LP/MP, Drink Levels 0-3)
Increased forward momentum for follow-up consistency
OD Freeflow Strikes (236PP, all Drink Levels)
25% starter scaling / 2-hit combo scaling added to 1st hit
Freeflow Strikes + Punches (236P~6P~6P, all Drink Levels)
Can now be SA3 canceled on the final hit
20% starter scaling added to the final hit
OD Freeflow Strikes + Punches (236PP~6P~6P, all Drink Levels)
Can now be SA2/SA3 canceled on the final hit
25% starter scaling added to 2nd/3rd hits
The OD Freeflow Strikes sequence itself still only counts as 1 move for scaling, so the follow-up punches themselves do not have their damage reduced
MP/HP Swagger Step (214MP/HP)
Juggle height and KD Advantage increased when hitting airborne opponents
OD Swagger Step (214PP)
Collision box extended upward to prevent whiffing under juggled opponents
LK Arrow Kick (623LK)
Active frames increased 7 → 10
Recovery decreased 55 → 52 (total animation time unchanged)
Reduced blowback when final 3 active frames hit airborne opponents
MK/HK/OD Arrow Kick (623MK/HK/KK)
Active frames increased 7 → 9
Recovery decreased 53 → 51 (total animation time unchanged)
Reduced blowback when final 2 active frames hit airborne opponents
LK Bakkai (236LK)
Combo-only hitboxes added to 3rd/4th hits for juggle consistency
HK Bakkai (236HK)
Startup reduced 26 → 25 (no change to total animation)
Combined with the 5HK changes, this allows 5HK > 236HK to combo naturally
1st active frame has reduced range (faster startup does not improve its anti-projectile properties)

patches.summary: Minor balance changes for all characters.
notes: Drive Gauge is replenished with Drinks even at DL0 ~ DL3 (1 Drive bar = 10000 units of Drive)
+2500 Drive (50% of DL4 gain): The Devil Inside (22P Drink)
+2500 Drive (25% of DL4 gain): Phantom Sway (2HK~HK~P)
+5000 Drive (50% of DL4 gain): Forward Throw + Drink, Full Moon Kick (DL2 6MK~MK~P), Freeflow Kicks (236P~6K~6K), SA1 Drink Ender
+10000 Drive (33.3% of DL4 gain): SA2 Activation
5HK
Removed the extended hurtbox on frames 5-8, making it easier to use as a ranged approach
2HK
Reduced pushback when spaced so that only the 2nd hit is blocked
Jamie is actually safer when connecting with the 1st hit's maximum range
j.HK
Now causes juggle state on both hits without CH/PC, making it a more rewarding air-to-air
Ransui Haze Headbutt (Close 6HK~4HK~P, DL4)
Increased forward movement during startup (Range: 1.649 → 1.935)
OD Freeflow Strikes (236PP)
DL4 version juggles the opponent higher on each hit
This makes a cancel into SA3/CA more consistent
MK Bakkai (236MK, DL2)
Extended combo-only hitbox upward on 4th hit to prevent it from dropping in juggles
Extended combo-only hitbox upward on 1st hit to ensure juggles will connect properly
Extended the input buffer at the end of the cinematic

patches.summary: Terry Release. Minor balance changes and bug fixes.
notes: Fixed issue where the damage would increase when the 1st or 2nd hit landed as a Counter-hit

patches.summary: M. Bison Release. Minor balance changes and bug fixes.
notes: Drive Damage on Block reduced by 200
Opponent's Drive Gain on Parry reduced by 2000
Version 1.05 caused SA1 to gain an extra hit, so these changes restore the values to their previous version

patches.summary: Akuma Release. Balance changes for all characters.
notes: Back Throw KD Advantage +38 → +26
Combined with universal distance nerf, prevents meterless strike/throw oki
5MP Block Advantage +1 → +2
5MK Hit Advantage +1 → +2 (also allows Punish Counter cancel to 214HP)
2MP Block Advantage 0 → -1; Hit Advantage +3 → +5 (also allows cancel to 214MP/214PP)
2MK extends a hurtbox on whiff until end of recovery
2HK Block Advantage -10 → -11; 2nd hit is no longer a low when 1st hit is blocked
1st hit does not increase juggle counter when juggled into (more lenient combo routes)
Falling Star Kick (6MK) hitconfirm window into DL2+ MK follow-up extended 15f → 17f (+1 hitstop and +1f longer cancel window)
Hermit's Elbow (4HP, DL3+) pushback on hit reduced; Punish Counter now links to 5LK, and to 5LP from more ranges
Bitter Strikes 1 (5LP~LK, DL1+) hitbox expanded, now hits more consistently from farther ranges
Bitter Strikes 2 (5LP~LK~MP, DL1+) +2f blockstun and +2f recovery on block (no change to advantage)
Drive Rush cancel timing shifted 1f earlier; combined with blockstun change, DR cancel Advantage +9/+1 → +10/+4
Ransui Haze Headbutt (6HK~4HK~P Close, DL4) startup 17f → 15f; allows combo from 6HK without Counter-hit or Drive Rush
Damage 700 → 850 (with DL4 scaling: 770 → 935); now counts as 2 hits of scaling when comboed into
Freeflow Strikes (236P~6P~6P, DL0-DL3) Drive Damage on block increased 1500 → 2500 on each punch; Drive Gain increased 700 → 1500 on each punch
DL4 version: hitbox expanded on 1st hit; Drive Gain increased overall 4900 → 5500 and shifted primarily to first attack (3000)
OD Freeflow Strikes 1 (236PP, DL0-DL3) Hit Advantage 0 → +1; all followup 6P attacks are no longer subject to combo scaling
Drive Damage on block increased 1500 → 2500 on all punches of 236PP~6P~6P sequence
OD Freeflow Strikes 1 (236PP, DL4) hitbox expanded on 1st hit; followup 6P attacks are no longer subject to combo scaling
Freeflow Kicks (236P/PP~6K~6K) Drive Damage on block increased 1500 → 2500 on each kick; Drive Gain increased 700 → 1000 on each kick (except OD)
HP Swagger Step (214HP) Block Advantage -5 → -3; recovery 17 → 16; KD Advantage +39 → +42 (safe jump setup)
OD Swagger Step (214PP) KD advantage increased by 3f vs. airborne opponents
LK Arrow Kick (623LK) startup 6f → 5f; starter scaling 30% added; can now juggle into 623KK/SA1/SA3 on high connect
Luminous Dive Kick (j.214K/KK) pushback on block reduced; hurtbox changed
Early frames are more vulnerable to projectiles, later frames are less vulnerable to low attacks
Bakkai (236K/KK) projectile invuln extended until end of active frames for all versions
Tenshin (63214K) no longer increases juggle counter on grounded opponents
OD Tenshin (63214KK) starter scaling 20% → 30%, now applies directly to next hit instead of 3rd combo hit
20% immediate scaling removed when comboed into
SA1 startup 10f → 8f, hitbox expanded for juggle consistency
No longer moves forward during screen freeze (cannot move through fast projectiles)
SA3/CA collision box expanded (less likely to drop in juggles)

patches.summary: Ed Release. Several balance changes and bug fixes.
notes: Forward Throw (LPLK)

Damage increased by 100 on both the regular version and Drink ender
Reduced pushback on Hit in the corner

Tensei Kick (2KK)
Can no longer be kara-canceled into Taunt on the first startup frame

Tensei Kick (2KK)

Ransui Haze Drink (6HK~4HK~P Far)

5LK (chained), SA1, SA3

patches.summary: Rashid Release. Bug fixes with some minor balance changes mainly for Modern controls.
notes: Modern 2L
Changed from 2LK → 2LP so that he has access to a 4-frame attack
